means: The contention failure reproduces at 7c0bba2~1, before mac-bench's commit existed, at the same rate as everywhere else and with the same signature - first_seq=0 in every one of the five. So it is not that commit's regression, was never fixed by 80d7006, and is not related to either. windows-desk read 0 of 10 at this very commit with their lever.
not_claimed: How far back the mid-stream defect goes. 7c0bba2~1 is one commit before, not an origin, and no bisect was run for it. It is at least as old as that commit.
settles: Two distinct defects, now on three independent grounds rather than one. The signature differs (first_seq 5 against 0, bounded prefix against variable mid-stream). The host differs (each lever inert on the other bench). And now the HISTORY differs: one was introduced by 7c0bba2 and fixed by 80d7006, the other predates both and is untouched by either.
